scope: Native source coverage for normal-anatomy teaching. Module membership is descriptive, not a cross-dataset anatomical mapping. Counts are source entries, not unique anatomical structures.

spl_nac.evidence: Real native T1/T2 and source labels; individual 1 mm grids retain their original half-millimeter origin difference.
spl_nac.coverage_note: Whole-brain T1/T2 and source labels, including cortical parcels and major deep structures.

cerebra.evidence: Template MRI and source-defined regional labels in their native source space.
cerebra.coverage_note: Whole-brain template T1/T2 and regional anatomical labels.

mida.evidence: Original categorical voxel model with source-defined tissue and anatomical classes.
mida.coverage_note: Whole-brain tissue and structure classes; no MRI or fine cortical parcellation.

hcp1065_tracts.evidence: Computed population streamline trajectories with the matching source-declared template MRI. Bundle extents and source display sampling are recorded.
hcp1065_tracts.coverage_note: Source association, projection, commissural and cerebellar streamline bundles.

hcp1065_prob.evidence: Original HCP1065 population probability fields in source-declared ICBM 2009a space, paired with an exact native template crop. Independent fields retain overlap; 0.20 surfaces are derived display contours.
hcp1065_prob.coverage_note: Source white-matter probability fields; these are not individual reconstructed trajectories.

z_anatomy.evidence: Independent source callosal and optic pathway surface models; original author geometry retained in native XYZ. Named detailed source objects retain their original definitions, hierarchy and geometry; no image correspondence or individual-variation frequency is inferred.
z_anatomy.coverage_note: Named source pathways with broad telencephalic white-matter source context. Context tissue surfaces do not define independent tract bundles.

mida.evidence: Whole-source artery and vein classes with their original head and neck extents.
mida.coverage_note: Broad source arterial and venous classes; named branches are not separated.

z_anatomy.evidence: Independent author-defined named arterial and venous models in their original source XYZ coordinates.
z_anatomy.coverage_note: Named arterial branches and venous channels in an independent anatomical model.

z_anatomy.evidence: Source CN I-XII, trigeminal roots, separate cochlear and vestibular components, visual pathway and petrous sensory context in original XYZ coordinates.
